<issue>
CommonLispLexer fails with NameError: name 'stack' is not defined

#### Description

The CommonLispLexer is throwing a NameError when trying to tokenize Common Lisp code. The error occurs because the `stack` variable is referenced but not defined in the `get_tokens_unprocessed` method.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pygments.lexers import CommonLispLexer

lexer = CommonLispLexer()
code = "(defun hello-world () (print \"Hello, World!\"))"
tokens = list(lexer.get_tokens(code))
```

This will raise:
```
NameError: name 'stack' is not defined
```

The issue affects any attempt to use the CommonLispLexer for syntax highlighting of Common Lisp code.
</issue>
